annotations.title: Publish a post or thread now

description: After the user approves the content group, draft and exact social destinations, publish now to destinations this content has not reached, reusing the same ID even if already published. Keep published content unchanged. Use one unique Idempotency-Key per approved request; reuse it with identical settings after a lost response. This returns acceptance, not delivery confirmation. Poll getPost for platform IDs and results. Never retry an uncertain publish with a new key.

allOf.description: Use one key per approved publish. Repeat the same key and settings after a lost response; never make a new key for an uncertain result.

Idempotency-Key.description: Use one key per approved publish. Repeat the same key and settings after a lost response; never make a new key for an uncertain result.

name: publishPost
